Based on the visual inspection of the time series plot, there is a distinct and significant upward shift in the values starting around index 670. The data remains relatively stable (fluctuating between roughly 0 and 8) until this point, after which it jumps to much higher values (between 15 and 22). This entire section at the end represents an anomaly compared to the rest of the series.

The anomalous range starts approximately where the sharp increase begins and continues to the end of the plotted data.

**Anomaly Range:**
- Starts: ~670 (where the sudden jump occurs)
- Ends: ~730 (end of the x-axis)

[[670, 730]]
